# VESC Config Saver

> Free, open-source web app that reads the full configuration of a VESC-based electric balance board (DIY Onewheel-style builds) over Bluetooth, explains every setting in plain language, and saves it as one JSON file. Read-only: it never writes to the board.

- Site: https://vesc.9dtr.com/
- Config viewer: https://vesc.9dtr.com/viewer.html
- Ride logger: https://vesc.9dtr.com/logger.html
- Source code: https://github.com/skermiebroTech/vesc-config-saver

## What it reads
- VESC motor configuration (mcconf) and app configuration (appconf)
- Package configurations: Refloat, Float, TNT (Trick and Trail), Balance, and any other package that registers a config page
- Every VESC device on the board's CAN bus, including a VESC Express used as a Bluetooth bridge, and the VESC Express's own settings
- Firmware 3.55 to 7.01, including the built-in Balance app in firmware 3.62 to 6.02

## Ride logger
- Live logging over Bluetooth, about 10 to 30 samples a second, logging every value the board offers (about 95 columns on a Refloat board). Every sample: all of Refloat's REALTIME_DATA fields (speed, ERPM, motor, directional, filtered and battery current, duty, voltage, battery %, temperatures, pitch, balance pitch, roll, foot sensors, remote input, every setpoint, balance current, loop frequency, odometer, distance, Ah/Wh used and charged, charging voltage and current, FOC d-axis current, GPS when fitted, and the package state, mode, pushback type, stop reason, alerts, wheel slip, charging and fatal error flags). Every 5th sample: COMM_GET_VALUES_SELECTIVE (fault codes, FOC currents and voltages, each MOSFET temperature, tachometer). Every 10th: COMM_GET_IMU_DATA (raw accelerometer, gyro, orientation). Every 20th: COMM_BMS_GET_VALUES (cell voltages) when a VESC BMS is present. Every 2nd sample (Refloat): the extra values from Refloat's internal live data command (REALTIME_DATA_INTERNAL, read by the value names from REALTIME_DATA_INTERNAL_IDS): loop timing and latency, ATR acceleration difference, speed boost, transition boost, booster torque. Refloat's alert log (ALERTS_LIST) is read at the start and end of each log and after a recording download; entries become events. Without Refloat, VESC values and IMU on every sample.
- Downloads Refloat's on-board data recording (DATA_RECORD command): a few seconds at the full balance-loop rate, recorded in the controller. Requires firmware with the data recording buffer (Refloat Extras, for example v7.00-rflt-xtras).
- Synced charts, an event list (disengages with their reason, pushbacks, wheel slip, alerts) and CSV export.

## Safety and privacy
- Only read commands are sent (COMM_FW_VERSION, COMM_PING_CAN, COMM_GET_MCCONF, COMM_GET_APPCONF, COMM_GET_CUSTOM_CONFIG_XML, COMM_GET_CUSTOM_CONFIG, wrapped in COMM_FORWARD_CAN for devices on CAN). No write, reboot or firmware commands exist in the code. The ride logger also sends COMM_GET_VALUES_SELECTIVE, COMM_GET_IMU_DATA, COMM_BMS_GET_VALUES and Refloat package commands (INFO, REALTIME_DATA, REALTIME_DATA_INTERNAL, REALTIME_DATA_INTERNAL_IDS, ALERTS_LIST, and DATA_RECORD status and download only; ALERTS_CONTROL is not used). Downloading Refloat's recording pauses it, the same as Refloat's own UI; it restarts on the next engage. The commands that start or stop recording or change its settings are not used.
- Passwords and PINs (VESC Express Wi-Fi passwords, Bluetooth PIN, TCP hub password) are replaced with "(hidden)" and never saved.
- Runs entirely in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.

## Requirements
- Reading from a board: Chrome on Android, or another Chromium browser with Web Bluetooth (Edge, Opera, Samsung Internet). Not Firefox or iPhone Safari.
- Viewing a saved file: any modern browser.

## Config viewer
Shows a card for every setting with its value, a plain-language explanation for beginners, a practical tip, the default value and whether it was changed. About 840 settings have hand-written beginner notes, covering every setting in VESC firmware 3.55 to 7.01, Refloat, Float, TNT, the Balance package and VESC Express.

## Tested hardware
JetFleet F6 (32s) with a built-in VESC Express, firmware 7.00, Refloat 1.3. Should also work with Thor 300/301/400, Tronic X12, and boards with an added VESC Express or an NRF Bluetooth module.
